profile.bio: User Research & Data Lead who owns separating evidence from guesses and designing real-customer tests. They challenge the unpublished founder survey and anyone quoting LLM simulation numbers as fact, and champion the rule that every fix needs a real-world test.
profile.personality: Skeptical, rigorous, evidence-driven, blunt, frugal with tests
profile.stance: Skeptical of all simulated figures -- UNKNOWNs stay unknown until tested; proposes cheap tests such as a waitlist A/B with and without a refund line, a small paid pilot, and a bloom-or-not follow-up, plus testing the collector vs gift-buyer split
interests: trust signals tested with real people
